dedupe_keys.name: ul fsri containerized lithium ion energy storage fire tests

description: UL Fire Safety Research Institute publishes sensor records from three installation-level lithium-ion battery energy-storage fire tests in Northbrook, Illinois. A heated cell initiated thermal runaway inside a twenty-foot container holding an initiating battery rack and target racks. The tests compare no active suppression, a clean-agent system and water suppression. CSV files contain sensor time series and separate event logs, with elapsed time referenced to initiation and local timestamps for synchronization. The repository also describes a supporting cell-level experiment and supplies schematics and observation notes. GitHub states MIT licensing; Zenodo labels the archived release Other Open. Public access is free. Coverage is limited to the 2020 experimental campaign and one mock-up configuration; the cells were fully charged but not electrically connected. A reviewer-assessed use is evaluating thermal-propagation and suppression assumptions in storage safety simulations. model-nist-fds-smokeview is a related fire modelling resource. No experiment data or simulation was executed.
